verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Linear migrating data from other tools (Jira import, import tooling), syncing GitHub issues, and listing a user's own Linear issues under My Issues. None of this documents a unified view that aggregates assigned tasks across several external project management tools. Import and migration are adjacent capabilities, not a cross-tool aggregated view.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view

citations.quote: Smoothly transition from Jira to Linear
Import data from other services into Linear
Connect GitHub to automate PR workflows, review code in Linear, sync issues and understand your codebase with Linear Agent
